comparison.objective: Extract one interleaved tissue while leaving the next tissue presented and the box properly placed.
comparison.physical_skill: Compliant-sheet pulling, separation control, and gentle box stabilization.

comparison.reason: This deformable separation task has no meaningful mechanism-tuning or dynamic force-response overlap.
